entities.summary: Marcus Stock is an English bishop of the Catholic Church who has been the tenth Bishop of Leeds since 2014. In 2025 he was appointed apostolic administrator to the Diocese of Middlesbrough, and in 2026 apostolic administrator to the Diocese of Hallam, both in addition to his role in Leeds.
